answer: Each new identity must send timing probes to five fixed beacons, and the latency vector it returns must place it at a distinct physical spot. Identities whose vectors fall in one narrow band merge into a single voter, so a dune of nearby farm servers collapses to one vote. Each extra fake needs its own uplink in a separate region, rented in one-month blocks, and a vertex of beacons sited on shale cannot be fooled from one datacentre.
